description: This module provides utility functions for post-processing subtitle files, including timestamp adjustments and text normalization based on word content. It includes functions for safe merging of subtitle corrections while respecting timing and content change thresholds.

methods.name: str apply_additional_compliance_fixes(path: str, processed_dir: str)
methods.description: Applies post-processing corrections to a subtitle file and outputs a new file copy.

methods.name: List[str] _extract_words(text: str)
methods.description: Extracts and lowercases words from a text, ignoring punctuation and whitespace.

methods.name: bool _should_update_text(old: str, new: str)
methods.description: Determines if subtitle text should be updated based on differences in word content.

methods.name: bool _time_change_is_significant(old_start: float, old_end: float, new_start: float, new_end: float)
methods.description: Checks if timestamp changes are significant enough (>= 1 second) to warrant an update.

methods.name: Dict conservative_merge_subtitle_update( original: Dict, proposal: Dict, )
methods.description: Merges proposed subtitle changes into the original, applying timestamp and text change thresholds.

ctags.name: _time_change_is_significant
ctags.pattern: /^def _time_change_is_significant(old_start: float, old_end: float, new_start: float, new_end: flo/
ctags.signature: (old_start: float, old_end: float, new_start: float, new_end: float)
